description: Bangkok's BTS, MRT and Airport Link stations with the number of rentals within 1 km and the median monthly rent by bedrooms (studio, 1, 2, 3+), busiest first, optionally for one line. Each station has its bkkradar.com page.

lang.description: Language of the titles and links: en, fr, th, ja (Japanese) or zh (simplified Chinese). Use the user's language.

limit.description: Stations to return, the busiest first: 40 by default, 200 at most.

line.description: Line code or name ("BTS-SUK", "BTS Sukhumvit", "MRT Blue"), or a whole network: "BTS", "MRT".

name: list_stations
title: List BTS/MRT stations with rents
